questions.question: What broke the skill install flow?
questions.gold_answer: load_local_skills looked for skills under a .claude/ prefix (manifest + .claude/skills/), but the repo actually keeps skills at top-level skills/, so the paths never matched.

questions.question: Why did skills never get symlinked into ~/.claude/skills/?
questions.gold_answer: Because the install script's expected paths never matched the repo's actual skill directory layout.

questions.question: Why does a skill that misses the initial scan never show up later in the same session?
questions.gold_answer: The harness only scans ~/.claude/skills/ once at startup and has no hot reload.

questions.question: Why is the fix's directory search capped at maxdepth 2?
questions.gold_answer: So fixture directories nested deeper under tests/fixtures/ don't get mistaken for real skills.

questions.question: Does the fix ever overwrite an existing symlink?
questions.gold_answer: No — it skips any name that's already linked rather than clobbering it.

questions.question: Does frontmatter validation happen before or after symlinking?
questions.gold_answer: Before — validation happens first, symlinking only after.

questions.question: How many skills load at session start after the fix?
What does a consumer repo need to do to pick up new skill updates after the fix?
questions.gold_answer: Nothing manual — it happens automatically the next time it bootstraps a session.
